payload.reason: The evidence indicates that regularization through auxiliary penalty terms can help maintain performance in the target domain while reducing catastrophic forgetting, suggesting that it does not hurt performance.

claims.text: Regularization of the fine-tuning process using auxiliary penalty terms does not harm performance in the target domain.
Combining different auxiliary penalty terms results in better performance, indicating that regularization can be beneficial.
Fine-tuning without regularization leads to significant performance degradation, highlighting the importance of regularization.
